core.title: Quantum-Enhanced and Machine Learning Framework for High-Accuracy Fatigue Life Prediction and Structural Analysis of Connecting Rod
core.abstract: The connecting rod is a critical mechanical component that transmits reciprocating motion from the piston to rotational motion in the crankshaft. Although connecting rods are traditionally manufactured from aluminum alloys, titanium alloys, or alloy steels, the demand for higher power-to-weight ratios has motivated the exploration of alternative materials supported by advanced computational validation methods. This study proposes a multilayer optimization framework for identifying the most suitable material for the connecting rod of a 110 cc four-stroke petrol engine. The component was modelled in Pro/ENGINEER, and high-fidelity Finite Element Analysis (FEA) was performed in ANSYS to evaluate the von Mises stress, total strain, and displacement under tensile and compressive loading. A deep neural network (DNN), trained on 1,500 FEA-generated samples, was employed as a fast surrogate model, whereas a Takagi–Sugeno fuzzy inference system was used for the multi-criteria material ranking. A quantum-inspired optimization layer, implemented as a Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) executed on the IBM Qiskit Aer state-vector simulator, was used to search the multidimensional design space of alloy candidates and cost-to-performance ratios. The fatigue life was quantified using the Basquin stress–life relation with Goodman's mean stress correction and Miner's linear damage accumulation rule. The DNN surrogate reproduced the FEA results with R2 = 0.987, RMSE = 2.41 MPa, and MAPE = 0.71% for stress prediction, outperforming the Random Forest and XGBoost baselines. Fatigue assessment revealed that AA-7075 operates above its endurance limit (fatigue safety factor 0.78), whereas 42CrMo4 alloy steel provides an infinite-life performance (fatigue safety factor 1.97) and is therefore recommended. The integration of quantum-inspired optimization and deep neural networks has demonstrated improved predictive accuracy compared with that of conventional simulation approaches.

article.lead: 连杆选材既要回应功率重量比需求，也要守住疲劳安全边界。这项研究将有限元分析、神经网络代理与量子启发优化结合，用于发动机连杆的材料筛选；阅读重点是预测精度与疲劳判据如何共同支持选材。

sections.title: 连杆选材：功率重量比之外还要看疲劳
paragraphs: 连杆将活塞的往复运动传递为曲轴的旋转运动，传统材料包括铝合金、钛合金和合金钢。面向更高功率重量比的需求，研究以110 cc四冲程汽油发动机连杆为对象，提出多层优化框架，寻找适合的材料。这里的任务不只是比较结构响应，还涉及成本与性能的权衡以及疲劳寿命评价。

sections.title: 有限元生成数据，代理模型参与材料筛选
paragraphs: 研究使用Pro/ENGINEER建立连杆模型，在ANSYS中进行高保真有限元分析，评价拉伸与压缩载荷下的von Mises应力、总应变和位移。随后，以1,500个有限元生成样本训练深度神经网络（DNN），作为快速代理模型，并使用Takagi–Sugeno模糊推理系统进行多准则材料排序。
优化层采用量子近似优化算法（QAOA），在IBM Qiskit Aer状态向量模拟器上运行，搜索涉及候选合金及成本性能比的多维设计空间。**这里的量子启发优化是在模拟器上执行，并非摘要所报告的量子硬件实验。**疲劳评价则结合Basquin应力—寿命关系、Goodman平均应力修正与Miner线性损伤累积准则。

sections.title: 应力预测贴近有限元，疲劳评价推荐42CrMo4
paragraphs: 摘要报告，DNN应力预测的R2 = 0.987、RMSE = 2.41 MPa、MAPE = 0.71%，表现优于随机森林和XGBoost基线。这些指标描述的是代理模型对有限元结果的复现能力，不应直接理解为对实物服役应力或寿命的验证精度。
疲劳评估显示，AA-7075的工作应力超过其疲劳极限，疲劳安全系数为0.78；42CrMo4合金钢的疲劳安全系数为1.97，被评为具有无限寿命表现，因此获得推荐。**“无限寿命”应放在本研究的疲劳计算条件下理解**，不能扩展为所有工况下均不会发生疲劳失效。

core.title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Inverse Design of Sequence-Controlled Terpolymers
core.abstract: Sequence-controlled polymers hold immense potential for advanced materials design, yet discovering their experimental recipes is bottlenecked by the high-dimension kinetic parameter space of multicomponent copolymerization. Traditional ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers provide rapid macrokinetic predictions but are fundamentally blind to explicit backbone microstructures. To bridge this gap, we use a stochastic simulation algorithm (SSA) engine to generate high-throughput terpolymer sequence data from a physically constrained parametric sweep across a 9-dimensional kinetic space, charting how feed stoichiometry and kinetic propensities dictate macromolecular structure. Information-theoretic analysis and t-SNE dimensionality reduction of the resulting 27-component triad frequency matrices for each simulation reveal profound microstructural degeneracies, demonstrating that traditional ensemble descriptors, such as the Harwood run number, are fundamentally incapable of describing sequence specifics. To accelerate optimization, we establish a digital twin strategy utilizing an XGBoost regressor to instantaneously predict localized chain-end propagation probabilities based on target sequence motifs. Finally, we demonstrate a closed-loop inverse design strategy that passes the 2 machine learning predictions to a deterministic root-finding optimizer, isolating exact initial monomer feeds and reactivity ratios needed to create them. By training an ML surrogate using explicit chain sequences from SSA, this framework provides a powerful alternative to classical macrokinetic equations, establishing an immediate, predictive tool to accelerate the discovery and reliable synthesis of sequence-controlled functional macromolecules.

core.title: Machine Learning-Based Fatigue Detection From EEG Signals: A Methodological Pilot Framework With Potential For Nursing Applications
core.venue: Journal of Clinical Practice and Research
core.abstract: Objective: Fatigue is a significant occupational health issue that adversely affects attention and decision-making. This study aimed to objectively predict fatigue levels using EEG signals and machine learning models and to develop a physiologically based assessment framework with potential future applications in nursing. Materials and Methods: Time-domain, frequency-domain, entropy, Hjorth, and wavelet features were extracted from EEG data collected from 12 participants aged 21–40 years, with fatigue levels labeled using various scales. Results: Classification performance varied across validation strategies. Under 5-fold cross-validation, Random Forest achieved the highest performance (accuracy=1.00, macro-F1=1.00), while KNN and NB also demonstrated strong performance. However, under LOOCV, sensitivity, precision, and macro-F1 values decreased despite relatively high accuracy. LOSO validation yielded more balanced results, with Random Forest maintaining the best performance (accuracy=0.97, macro-F1=0.91). Conclusion: EEG-derived features provide valuable information for fatigue assessment. Although high performance was achieved under certain validation strategies, subject-independent evaluation revealed more realistic performance levels. The proposed framework offers a practical approach to fatigue monitoring. Future studies should focus on larger, domain-specific datasets and multimodal integration to enhance generalizability.

core.title: Metamaterials as transducers for structural health monitoring: a critical review and perspective
core.abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) has traditionally relied on distributed sensors, data acquisition systems, signal transmission, and external data processing to assess the condition of engineering structures. Although this sensor-centric paradigm enables reliable damage detection, it remains limited by system complexity, wiring, power consumption, maintenance, and scalability. Recent advances in metamaterials offer an alternative approach in which the material itself participates in sensing by transducing structural responses into measurable information through its engineered architecture. This review examines how architected metamaterials encode, transform, and communicate structural information for next-generation SHM. Recent developments are organized according to the physical domain of the generated information: visual information, including shape transformation, structural colour, mechanochromism, and mechanoluminescence; electromagnetic information, including electrical, capacitive, piezoelectric, triboelectric, radio-frequency, metasurface, and passive wireless responses; and wave information, including elastic-wave propagation, bandgaps, resonance shifts, mode conversion, localization, and mechanical filtering;. Enabling technologies, including inverse design, topology optimization, additive manufacturing, machine learning, and digital twins, are highlighted for developing multifunctional metamaterials capable of sensing, filtering, amplifying, and communicating structural information. Finally, future opportunities and challenges are outlined for material-centric SHM, in which architected materials evolve from passive structural components into intrinsically intelligent systems that physically process and communicate information before it reaches conventional electronic systems.

sections.title: 从外加传感器转向材料参与感知
paragraphs: 传统结构健康监测依靠分布式传感器、数据采集、信号传输与外部数据处理判断结构状态。摘要指出，这种模式能够实现可靠的损伤检测，但仍受到系统复杂性、布线、功耗、维护和规模扩展等因素限制。
超材料提供的替代思路，是利用经过设计的材料架构，把结构响应转化为可测量的信息。关注点由此从“如何布置传感器”，拓展到“材料结构如何参与信息生成与传递”。

摘要还强调逆向设计、拓扑优化、增材制造、机器学习和数字孪生等支撑技术，讨论它们与多功能超材料发展的联系；但未交代文献检索策略、筛选标准或具体设计流程。

extended.title: Biaxial tension-torsion coupling fatigue resonance of single-walled MoS2 nanotubes.
extended.abstract: Fatigue characteristics of nanotubes are crucial for enhancing the reliability of flexible nanoelectronic devices. This work systematically investigates fatigue behaviors of single-walled MoS2 nanotubes subjected to biaxial tensile-torsion coupling loading. Results show that fatigue life decreases as torsion angle and axial excitation frequency increase. More interestingly, fatigue life exhibits a non-monotonic decrease with increasing excitation frequency for all torsion angles, presenting two distinct minima in the low-to-mid frequency range. We have developed a method for calculating natural frequencies under combined biaxial tension and torsion, and discovered that the first minimum corresponds to the tensile natural frequency, while the second corresponds to its first harmonic. In the high-frequency regime, however, fatigue life rapidly drops into a broad minimum plateau governed by strain-rate effects rather than sharp harmonic resonances. Namely, the minimum of these two fatigue lives is caused by fatigue resonance due to excitation frequency being equal to the system's natural frequency. We also find that fatigue energy is distributed and dissipated at the excitation frequency and natural frequency. When excitation frequency matches the natural frequency, fatigue life reaches a minimum due to the dissipation of most natural frequency phonons. These observations provide guidance for considering fatigue resonance under tension-torsion coupling to improve the service life of nanotube-based devices.

article.lead: 拉伸与扭转共同作用时，纳米管的疲劳寿命为何会在某些激励频率附近出现低谷？这项研究将寿命变化与固有频率、谐波及应变率效应联系起来，为理解纳米管器件的疲劳可靠性提供线索。

sections.title: 拉伸—扭转耦合下，寿命如何随频率变化
paragraphs: 纳米管的疲劳特性关系到纳米管器件的服役寿命。本研究关注双轴拉伸—扭转耦合载荷下的疲劳行为，考察扭转角度、轴向激励频率与疲劳寿命的关系。值得关注的不只是寿命随频率升高而缩短的总体趋势，还有其中并不单调的局部变化。

sections.title: 计算耦合载荷下的固有频率
paragraphs: 摘要明确介绍，作者建立了拉伸与扭转共同作用下的固有频率计算方法，并将计算得到的频率与疲劳寿命低谷相联系。摘要还报告了疲劳能量在激励频率和固有频率处的分布与耗散，但未交代具体计算流程、能量分析方法或疲劳寿命的判定标准。

sections.title: 低中频的两个低谷，与高频宽平台不同
paragraphs: 结果显示，扭转角度增大、轴向激励频率升高时，疲劳寿命总体下降。不过，在所有考察的扭转角度下，寿命随激励频率的变化都不是单调下降：低至中频范围内出现两个明显低谷，分别对应拉伸固有频率及其第一谐波。
进入高频范围后，疲劳寿命迅速降至一个较宽的最低值平台。作者将这一平台归因于应变率效应，而不是尖锐的谐波共振。因此，摘要对低中频低谷和高频平台给出了不同的机制解释，不能将两者一概视为同一种共振现象。
在能量层面，摘要报告疲劳能量分布并耗散于激励频率和固有频率处。当激励频率与固有频率匹配时，作者将寿命最低值归因于大部分固有频率声子的耗散。这提供了理解疲劳共振的能量视角，但摘要没有展开这一解释的详细证据。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能界定结果的适用范围
paragraphs: 仅凭当前摘要，无法判断研究对象的样本规模、几何尺寸、边界条件、载荷参数范围，以及是否设置其他加载方式作为比较；也无法判断固有频率计算与机制解释经过了哪些独立验证。这些属于摘要未交代的信息，不代表论文没有开展相关工作。器件寿命改善在此是应用指向，不能视为已经验证的效果。

paragraphs: 阅读启发：进一步阅读时，可重点关注固有频率如何随耦合载荷变化、寿命低谷与频率匹配的证据，以及作者如何区分共振效应和应变率效应。对疲劳可靠性而言，本文提示值得关注激励频率与结构固有频率的相对关系，但尚不能据此直接给出器件的安全工作频段。

extended.title: Multiscale Leakage Modeling of PEMFC Gasket–MEA Frame Interfaces: A Mini-Review
extended.abstract: To meet the stringent durability requirements of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) for heavy-duty applications, sealing reliability must be evaluated beyond the initial assembly state and linked to the long-term evolution of interfacial contact and gas-loss behavior. This mini-review focuses on gasket–MEA frame sealing interfaces in PEMFCs, with particular emphasis on flexible–flexible contact. It systematically examines recent progress in multiscale geometric characterization and reconstruction, constitutive and contact evolution under assembly and service loads, the competition between interfacial leakage and bulk material permeation, and the development of predictive modeling strategies from deterministic simulations to uncertainty-aware and data-assisted frameworks. The review highlights power spectral density (PSD)- and fractal-based surface reconstruction methods, discusses visco-hyperelastic and chemo-thermo-mechanical descriptions relevant to elastomer aging and contact-pressure retention, and clarifies that gas-loss behavior depends on a service-dependent transition between pressure-driven interfacial leakage and temperature-sensitive bulk permeation. It further summarizes multiscale transport modeling approaches involving slip-flow and Knudsen-scale effects, as well as recent advances in fluid–structure interaction, stochastic tolerance analysis, and surrogate-assisted prediction. Finally, the review outlines key future needs in lifecycle-oriented interface modeling, in situ experimental validation, benchmark data sets, and the integration of physics-informed machine learning with multiscale leakage prediction for health-state assessment and predictive maintenance of PEMFC stacks.

sections.title: 从初始密封转向长期接触演变
paragraphs: 质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）的重载应用提出了严格的耐久性要求。摘要强调，密封评价需要超越初始装配状态，把界面接触的长期变化与气体损失联系起来。本文聚焦垫片—膜电极组件（MEA）框架密封界面，尤其关注柔性—柔性接触。
这一问题不仅涉及界面是否存在泄漏通道，还涉及气体通过材料本体渗透的过程。因此，理解密封可靠性需要同时考虑接触状态、材料响应与服役条件，而不能仅凭初始密封状态判断长期表现。

extended.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
extended.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

extended.title: Quantum Topological Neural Operators and Digital Twin Intelligence for Multiscale Climate, Energy, Hydrological, Urban, Industrial and Health Systems
extended.venue: International Journal of Academic and Industrial Research Innovations(IJAIRI)
extended.abstract: Abstract: Complex climate, energy, hydrological, urban, industrial and health systems are increasingly monitored through heterogeneous sensor, simulation and observational infrastructures, yet their digital twins remain fragmented by domain-specific models, incompatible scales and weak representations of nonlinear topology. This paper develops a unified model-based framework termed Quantum Topological Neural Operator Digital Twin Intelligence (QTNODT). The framework combines persistent and graph-topological representations, quantum or quantum-inspired feature encodings, neural operators for learning solution mappings between function spaces, digital-twin data assimilation, uncertainty quantification and risk-aware optimisation. The study synthesises the supplied literature on neural operators, quantum machine intelligence, topological learning, smart-grid stability, water twins, urban resilience, predictive-maintenance twins, climate-risk modelling and multimodal health intelligence. A coupled mathematical formulation is proposed in which sector states evolve through dynamic operators and are linked by cross-sector interaction matrices, while topological signatures act as scale-robust structural constraints. A normalized 0-10 numerical demonstration yields a weighted domain score of 8.141 and a risk-adjusted QTNODT score of 7.813 under an illustrative uncertainty penalty, indicating how readiness, twin fidelity, topological stability, computational capacity and governance can be combined without presenting simulated values as empirical evidence. The framework contributes a common analytical language for cross-domain forecasting, resilience assessment and intervention design. Its principal value is methodological: it specifies testable interfaces among data, topology, operators, twins and decisions, while making clear that empirical validation requires real-world sector datasets, benchmark comparisons and prospective evaluation. Keywords: quantum topological intelligence; neural operators; digital twins; persistent homology; graph topology; climate risk; smart grids; hydrological intelligence; urban resilience; Industry 5.0; predictive maintenance; precision health; uncertainty quantification; multiscale systems; scientific machine learning

papers.title: Quantum-Enhanced and Machine Learning Framework for High-Accuracy Fatigue Life Prediction and Structural Analysis of Connecting Rod
papers.abstract: The connecting rod is a critical mechanical component that transmits reciprocating motion from the piston to rotational motion in the crankshaft. Although connecting rods are traditionally manufactured from aluminum alloys, titanium alloys, or alloy steels, the demand for higher power-to-weight ratios has motivated the exploration of alternative materials supported by advanced computational validation methods. This study proposes a multilayer optimization framework for identifying the most suitable material for the connecting rod of a 110 cc four-stroke petrol engine. The component was modelled in Pro/ENGINEER, and high-fidelity Finite Element Analysis (FEA) was performed in ANSYS to evaluate the von Mises stress, total strain, and displacement under tensile and compressive loading. A deep neural network (DNN), trained on 1,500 FEA-generated samples, was employed as a fast surrogate model, whereas a Takagi–Sugeno fuzzy inference system was used for the multi-criteria material ranking. A quantum-inspired optimization layer, implemented as a Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) executed on the IBM Qiskit Aer state-vector simulator, was used to search the multidimensional design space of alloy candidates and cost-to-performance ratios. The fatigue life was quantified using the Basquin stress–life relation with Goodman's mean stress correction and Miner's linear damage accumulation rule. The DNN surrogate reproduced the FEA results with R2 = 0.987, RMSE = 2.41 MPa, and MAPE = 0.71% for stress prediction, outperforming the Random Forest and XGBoost baselines. Fatigue assessment revealed that AA-7075 operates above its endurance limit (fatigue safety factor 0.78), whereas 42CrMo4 alloy steel provides an infinite-life performance (fatigue safety factor 1.97) and is therefore recommended. The integration of quantum-inspired optimization and deep neural networks has demonstrated improved predictive accuracy compared with that of conventional simulation approaches.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Inverse Design of Sequence-Controlled Terpolymers
papers.abstract: Sequence-controlled polymers hold immense potential for advanced materials design, yet discovering their experimental recipes is bottlenecked by the high-dimension kinetic parameter space of multicomponent copolymerization. Traditional ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers provide rapid macrokinetic predictions but are fundamentally blind to explicit backbone microstructures. To bridge this gap, we use a stochastic simulation algorithm (SSA) engine to generate high-throughput terpolymer sequence data from a physically constrained parametric sweep across a 9-dimensional kinetic space, charting how feed stoichiometry and kinetic propensities dictate macromolecular structure. Information-theoretic analysis and t-SNE dimensionality reduction of the resulting 27-component triad frequency matrices for each simulation reveal profound microstructural degeneracies, demonstrating that traditional ensemble descriptors, such as the Harwood run number, are fundamentally incapable of describing sequence specifics. To accelerate optimization, we establish a digital twin strategy utilizing an XGBoost regressor to instantaneously predict localized chain-end propagation probabilities based on target sequence motifs. Finally, we demonstrate a closed-loop inverse design strategy that passes the 2 machine learning predictions to a deterministic root-finding optimizer, isolating exact initial monomer feeds and reactivity ratios needed to create them. By training an ML surrogate using explicit chain sequences from SSA, this framework provides a powerful alternative to classical macrokinetic equations, establishing an immediate, predictive tool to accelerate the discovery and reliable synthesis of sequence-controlled functional macromolecules.

papers.venue: Journal of Clinical Practice and Research
papers.abstract: Objective: Fatigue is a significant occupational health issue that adversely affects attention and decision-making. This study aimed to objectively predict fatigue levels using EEG signals and machine learning models and to develop a physiologically based assessment framework with potential future applications in nursing. Materials and Methods: Time-domain, frequency-domain, entropy, Hjorth, and wavelet features were extracted from EEG data collected from 12 participants aged 21–40 years, with fatigue levels labeled using various scales. Results: Classification performance varied across validation strategies. Under 5-fold cross-validation, Random Forest achieved the highest performance (accuracy=1.00, macro-F1=1.00), while KNN and NB also demonstrated strong performance. However, under LOOCV, sensitivity, precision, and macro-F1 values decreased despite relatively high accuracy. LOSO validation yielded more balanced results, with Random Forest maintaining the best performance (accuracy=0.97, macro-F1=0.91). Conclusion: EEG-derived features provide valuable information for fatigue assessment. Although high performance was achieved under certain validation strategies, subject-independent evaluation revealed more realistic performance levels. papers.title: Metamaterials as transducers for structural health monitoring: a critical review and perspective
papers.abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) has traditionally relied on distributed sensors, data acquisition systems, signal transmission, and external data processing to assess the condition of engineering structures. Although this sensor-centric paradigm enables reliable damage detection, it remains limited by system complexity, wiring, power consumption, maintenance, and scalability. Recent advances in metamaterials offer an alternative approach in which the material itself participates in sensing by transducing structural responses into measurable information through its engineered architecture. This review examines how architected metamaterials encode, transform, and communicate structural information for next-generation SHM. Recent developments are organized according to the physical domain of the generated information: visual information, including shape transformation, structural colour, mechanochromism, and mechanoluminescence; electromagnetic information, including electrical, capacitive, piezoelectric, triboelectric, radio-frequency, metasurface, and passive wireless responses; and wave information, including elastic-wave propagation, bandgaps, resonance shifts, mode conversion, localization, and mechanical filtering;. Enabling technologies, including inverse design, topology optimization, additive manufacturing, machine learning, and digital twins, are highlighted for developing multifunctional metamaterials capable of sensing, filtering, amplifying, and communicating structural information. Finally, future opportunities and challenges are outlined for material-centric SHM, in which architected materials evolve from passive structural components into intrinsically intelligent systems that physically process and communicate information before it reaches conventional electronic systems.

papers.title: Biaxial tension-torsion coupling fatigue resonance of single-walled MoS2 nanotubes.
papers.abstract: Fatigue characteristics of nanotubes are crucial for enhancing the reliability of flexible nanoelectronic devices. This work systematically investigates fatigue behaviors of single-walled MoS2 nanotubes subjected to biaxial tensile-torsion coupling loading. Results show that fatigue life decreases as torsion angle and axial excitation frequency increase. More interestingly, fatigue life exhibits a non-monotonic decrease with increasing excitation frequency for all torsion angles, presenting two distinct minima in the low-to-mid frequency range. We have developed a method for calculating natural frequencies under combined biaxial tension and torsion, and discovered that the first minimum corresponds to the tensile natural frequency, while the second corresponds to its first harmonic. In the high-frequency regime, however, fatigue life rapidly drops into a broad minimum plateau governed by strain-rate effects rather than sharp harmonic resonances. Namely, the minimum of these two fatigue lives is caused by fatigue resonance due to excitation frequency being equal to the system's natural frequency. We also find that fatigue energy is distributed and dissipated at the excitation frequency and natural frequency. When excitation frequency matches the natural frequency, fatigue life reaches a minimum due to the dissipation of most natural frequency phonons. These observations provide guidance for considering fatigue resonance under tension-torsion coupling to improve the service life of nanotube-based devices.

paragraphs: 摘要明确介绍，作者建立了拉伸与扭转共同作用下的固有频率计算方法，并将计算得到的频率与疲劳寿命低谷相联系。摘要还报告了疲劳能量在激励频率和固有频率处的分布与耗散，但未交代具体计算流程、能量分析方法或疲劳寿命的判定标准。

sections.title: 低中频的两个低谷，与高频宽平台不同
paragraphs: 结果显示，扭转角度增大、轴向激励频率升高时，疲劳寿命总体下降。不过，在所有考察的扭转角度下，寿命随激励频率的变化都不是单调下降：低至中频范围内出现两个明显低谷，分别对应拉伸固有频率及其第一谐波。
进入高频范围后，疲劳寿命迅速降至一个较宽的最低值平台。作者将这一平台归因于应变率效应，而不是尖锐的谐波共振。因此，摘要对低中频低谷和高频平台给出了不同的机制解释，不能将两者一概视为同一种共振现象。
在能量层面，摘要报告疲劳能量分布并耗散于激励频率和固有频率处。当激励频率与固有频率匹配时，作者将寿命最低值归因于大部分固有频率声子的耗散。这提供了理解疲劳共振的能量视角，但摘要没有展开这一解释的详细证据。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能界定结果的适用范围
paragraphs: 仅凭当前摘要，无法判断研究对象的样本规模、几何尺寸、边界条件、载荷参数范围，以及是否设置其他加载方式作为比较；也无法判断固有频率计算与机制解释经过了哪些独立验证。这些属于摘要未交代的信息，不代表论文没有开展相关工作。器件寿命改善在此是应用指向，不能视为已经验证的效果。

paragraphs: 阅读启发：进一步阅读时，可重点关注固有频率如何随耦合载荷变化、寿命低谷与频率匹配的证据，以及作者如何区分共振效应和应变率效应。对疲劳可靠性而言，本文提示值得关注激励频率与结构固有频率的相对关系，但尚不能据此直接给出器件的安全工作频段。

papers.title: Multiscale Leakage Modeling of PEMFC Gasket–MEA Frame Interfaces: A Mini-Review
papers.abstract: To meet the stringent durability requirements of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) for heavy-duty applications, sealing reliability must be evaluated beyond the initial assembly state and linked to the long-term evolution of interfacial contact and gas-loss behavior. This mini-review focuses on gasket–MEA frame sealing interfaces in PEMFCs, with particular emphasis on flexible–flexible contact. It systematically examines recent progress in multiscale geometric characterization and reconstruction, constitutive and contact evolution under assembly and service loads, the competition between interfacial leakage and bulk material permeation, and the development of predictive modeling strategies from deterministic simulations to uncertainty-aware and data-assisted frameworks. The review highlights power spectral density (PSD)- and fractal-based surface reconstruction methods, discusses visco-hyperelastic and chemo-thermo-mechanical descriptions relevant to elastomer aging and contact-pressure retention, and clarifies that gas-loss behavior depends on a service-dependent transition between pressure-driven interfacial leakage and temperature-sensitive bulk permeation. It further summarizes multiscale transport modeling approaches involving slip-flow and Knudsen-scale effects, as well as recent advances in fluid–structure interaction, stochastic tolerance analysis, and surrogate-assisted prediction. Finally, the review outlines key future needs in lifecycle-oriented interface modeling, in situ experimental validation, benchmark data sets, and the integration of physics-informed machine learning with multiscale leakage prediction for health-state assessment and predictive maintenance of PEMFC stacks.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇面向重载质子交换膜燃料电池密封可靠性的简评，聚焦垫片—膜电极组件边框的柔性—柔性接触界面。摘要梳理表面重构、材料老化与接触演化、界面泄漏和材料体相渗透的竞争，以及多尺度输运和不确定性预测方法。核心认识是密封评价不能停留于初始装配状态，而应关联服役中的接触与气体损失演化。作者提出原位验证、基准数据集和物理信息机器学习等未来需求；本解读仅依据摘要，不涉及全文实验核验。[摘要]

article.lead: 重载应用中的质子交换膜燃料电池，密封可靠性不能只看装配时是否严密，还要关注服役过程中接触状态与气体损失如何演变。这篇短综述围绕垫片—膜电极组件框架界面，梳理从表面形貌、材料老化到多尺度泄漏预测的关联，为理解长期密封可靠性提供阅读线索。

sections.title: 从初始密封转向长期接触演变
paragraphs: 质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）的重载应用提出了严格的耐久性要求。摘要强调，密封评价需要超越初始装配状态，把界面接触的长期变化与气体损失联系起来。本文聚焦垫片—膜电极组件（MEA）框架密封界面，尤其关注柔性—柔性接触。
这一问题不仅涉及界面是否存在泄漏通道，还涉及气体通过材料本体渗透的过程。因此，理解密封可靠性需要同时考虑接触状态、材料响应与服役条件，而不能仅凭初始密封状态判断长期表现。

sections.title: 以多尺度建模串联形貌、接触与输运
paragraphs: 本文是一篇短综述，摘要描述的是对相关进展的系统梳理，而非一项新实验。其内容覆盖多尺度几何表征与重构、装配及服役载荷下的本构与接触演变，以及从确定性模拟走向考虑不确定性和数据辅助的预测框架。
具体方法包括基于功率谱密度（PSD）与分形的表面重构，以及用于描述弹性体老化和接触压力保持的黏弹性—超弹性、化学—热—力学模型。综述还涉及滑移流与克努森尺度效应、流固耦合、随机公差分析和代理模型辅助预测。

sections.title: 气体损失的主导机制随服役条件转变
paragraphs: 摘要明确指出，气体损失行为取决于随服役条件变化的机制转变：一侧是压力驱动的界面泄漏，另一侧是对温度敏感的材料本体渗透。**界面泄漏与本体渗透需要共同考虑**，不能把气体损失简单归结为其中一种机制。
综述同时归纳了流固耦合、随机公差分析与代理辅助预测的近期进展。不过，摘要未给出这些方法的定量精度、计算成本或相互比较结果，因此这里的发现应理解为机制认识与建模进展的概括，而非某种模型优越性的验证。

papers.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.
papers.summary: 大语言模型接入专业诊断工具后，是否真的优于工具本身？本文在五个工业诊断数据集上考察这一问题，并用配对重复调用区分外部建议影响与输出不稳定性。四个具有直接集成比较的数据集均未显示隐式集成的稳定优势；确认集上，集成虽改善模型表现，却仍落后于专业工具。[摘要] 解读：论文值得智能运维研究者阅读，重点不是增强模型单体，而是检查集成层是否真正利用了不同来源的互补信息。

papers.title: Fatigue S–N Curve Dataset for Carbon and Low-Alloy Steels
papers.abstract: The dataset contains two files: NIMSfatiguelife.xlsx and 209_100.xlsx. NIMSfatiguelife.xlsx contains the curated fatigue test data used in this study. For curve-level modeling, the experimental fatigue data for each material were fitted using the Stüssi equation to obtain median S–N curves and subsequently resampled over a unified fatigue-life range; the resulting processed data are provided in 209_100.xlsx. Material identifiers were standardized to maintain consistency between the two files. The dataset supports fatigue-data analysis, S–N curve modeling, and the development and evaluation of machine-learning-based S–N curve prediction models.

papers.venue: International Journal of Academic and Industrial Research Innovations(IJAIRI)
papers.abstract: Abstract: Complex climate, energy, hydrological, urban, industrial and health systems are increasingly monitored through heterogeneous sensor, simulation and observational infrastructures, yet their digital twins remain fragmented by domain-specific models, incompatible scales and weak representations of nonlinear topology. This paper develops a unified model-based framework termed Quantum Topological Neural Operator Digital Twin Intelligence (QTNODT). The framework combines persistent and graph-topological representations, quantum or quantum-inspired feature encodings, neural operators for learning solution mappings between function spaces, digital-twin data assimilation, uncertainty quantification and risk-aware optimisation. The study synthesises the supplied literature on neural operators, quantum machine intelligence, topological learning, smart-grid stability, water twins, urban resilience, predictive-maintenance twins, climate-risk modelling and multimodal health intelligence. A coupled mathematical formulation is proposed in which sector states evolve through dynamic operators and are linked by cross-sector interaction matrices, while topological signatures act as scale-robust structural constraints. A normalized 0-10 numerical demonstration yields a weighted domain score of 8.141 and a risk-adjusted QTNODT score of 7.813 under an illustrative uncertainty penalty, indicating how readiness, twin fidelity, topological stability, computational capacity and governance can be combined without presenting simulated values as empirical evidence. The framework contributes a common analytical language for cross-domain forecasting, resilience assessment and intervention design. Its principal value is methodological: it specifies testable interfaces among data, topology, operators, twins and decisions, while making clear that empirical validation requires real-world sector datasets, benchmark comparisons and prospective evaluation. Keywords: quantum topological intelligence; neural operators; digital twins; persistent homology; graph topology; climate risk; smart grids; hydrological intelligence; urban resilience; Industry 5.0; predictive maintenance; precision health; uncertainty quantification; multiscale systems; scientific machine learning

article.lead: 跨领域数字孪生的难点，不只是数据来源不同，还在于模型尺度不兼容、系统结构难以统一表达。这项研究提出QTNODT框架，尝试连接拓扑、神经算子与风险决策；阅读价值在于理解其方法接口，而非把示例评分当作应用成效。

sections.title: 数据越来越多，数字孪生为何仍然割裂
paragraphs: 气候、能源、水文、城市、工业和健康系统，正通过异构传感器、仿真与观测基础设施持续获得数据。但摘要指出，各领域专用模型、互不兼容的尺度，以及对非线性拓扑结构的薄弱表达，仍使数字孪生彼此割裂。研究希望为跨领域预测、韧性评估和干预设计建立共同的分析语言。

sections.title: 用拓扑约束与动态算子连接领域状态
paragraphs: 作者综合神经算子、量子机器智能、拓扑学习及多个应用领域的文献，提出“量子拓扑神经算子数字孪生智能”（QTNODT）框架。其组成包括持久性与图拓扑表征、量子或量子启发式特征编码、学习函数空间之间解映射的神经算子，以及数字孪生数据同化、不确定性量化和风险感知优化。
在所提出的耦合数学表述中，各领域状态通过动态算子演化，跨领域交互矩阵负责建立联系，拓扑特征则作为具有尺度稳健性的结构约束。这里描述的是框架组成与数学关系，不能据此认定它已在量子硬件上实现，或已完成跨领域系统部署。

sections.title: 评分演示展示整合方式，不代表实证性能
paragraphs: 摘要报告了一项归一化至0–10的数值演示：加权领域得分为8.141，在示例性不确定性惩罚下，风险调整后的QTNODT得分为7.813。演示用于说明如何综合就绪程度、孪生保真度、拓扑稳定性、计算能力与治理因素，**不是对真实系统性能的实证测量**。
研究明确将主要价值定位于方法论：为数据、拓扑、算子、孪生和决策之间规定可检验的接口。因此，当前可概括的成果是统一框架与评分整合示例，而不是已经证明预测更准确、系统更可靠或干预更有效。

sections.title: 真实数据、基准比较与前瞻验证仍是关键
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断实际样本规模与构成、比较基线的设置，以及验证覆盖哪些领域、尺度和运行条件；这些信息未报告，不等于论文没有涉及。摘要明确指出，实证验证需要真实领域数据集、基准比较和前瞻性评估。因此，数值演示不足以支持跨领域泛化能力或量子相关性能优势的结论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注预测维护中的接口如何落地
paragraphs: 阅读启发：面向智能运维，可进一步关注框架如何把设备状态数据、拓扑表征、动态预测与风险决策对应起来。后续阅读值得追问：这些接口如何被具体定义？不确定性怎样进入评分与决策？预测维护场景中的证据来自示例还是实际评估？这些问题有助于区分框架的组织价值与尚待验证的应用效果。
